atlas:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE square 3-by-3 ATLAS of monochrome tabletop STATUS GLYPHS. Image 1 is STYLE AND FORMAT reference only. Image 2 supplies two approved design anchors ONLY: primary five-point-star action mark in its cell 2, and blood-drop outer silhouette in its cell 4. Do not copy other old glyphs. Exactly nine equal square cells, strict row-major order; no drawn grid or labels. PURE SOLID WHITE silhouettes on perfectly clean PURE BLACK. No grey, colors, gradients, shading, texture, speckles, distressed edges, outlines, letters, numerals, frames or watermark. Broad sober heavy stencil shapes, very wide functional negative-space cuts, legible at 16-24 px. Each complete glyph centered in its own cell, at most 65 percent of the cell width or height, with generous black separation and no part crossing a cell edge. Abstract video-game symbols only; no realistic injuries.
EXACT ROW-MAJOR CONTENTS:
CELL 1: BONUS ACTION, OPTION A: ONE modest FOUR-POINT STAR at upper left, with ONE separate large CHECK MARK at lower right. The four-point star is noticeably SMALLER and less commanding than the broad primary five-point star in reference image 2 cell 2. Four SHORT points and a broad center, not a needle-thin sparkle. Keep a generous black gap before the check. No five-point primary star, extra stars, plus sign, medical cross, letters or surrounding frame.
CELL 2: BONUS ACTION, OPTION B: ONE RIGHT-HAND HALF of a broad FIVE-POINT STAR, sliced cleanly down its vertical center, with ONE separate large CHECK MARK at lower right. A clear straight vertical cut edge at left; retain the top point, right upper point and right lower point of the primary star. Half the main action symbol indicates a lesser secondary action. No outline or ghost half, full star, extra stars, arrow, frame, letters or tiny marks.
CELL 3: CUT-WOUND BLEED: ONE broad smooth upright WHITE BLOOD DROP with ONE WIDE DIAGONAL BLACK SLASH cut INSIDE it, bottom left to upper right. The slash is thick and tapered like a simple incision. It remains wholly INSIDE the drop, leaving a thick continuous white rim on every side. Match the approved drop silhouette in reference image 2 cell 4. No external wound lips, hanging drops, round holes, weapons, realistic flesh or fine scratches.
CELL 4: ARTERIAL BLEED: ONE broad smooth upright WHITE BLOOD DROP with ONE LARGE BLACK BRANCHING BLOOD-VESSEL DIAGRAM INSIDE: a thick central stem rises from the lower center and splits into two broad curved branches toward upper left and upper right. Include ONE short white interruption across one black branch to suggest a rupture. Keep a continuous thick white rim around the entire diagram. Match the approved drop in reference image 2 cell 4. Black channels are WIDE and simple, no tiny branches, external fountain, pipe, spray, flower, lettering or extra drops.
CELL 5: LIGHT BLEED / HIT-POINT LOSS: ONE broad smooth upright WHITE BLOOD DROP containing exactly ONE LARGE SHORT HORIZONTAL BLACK MINUS BAR across its center. Thick broad rounded bar fully INSIDE the drop, surrounded by generous white space; it indicates a small loss. Match the approved drop silhouette in reference image 2 cell 4. No other holes, spots, numerals, cross, plus, heart, slash, external drops or decorative marks.
CELL 6: HYDRAULIC LEAK: ONE thick FLEXIBLE REINFORCED HOSE curving loosely diagonally from upper left to lower right, BROKEN HALF-WAY ALONG ITS LENGTH. The two frayed torn ends face one another across a clear wide black gap near the center; three SHORT THICK reinforcement strands jut from the torn ends. ONE LARGE OIL DROP falls below the break. One stout crimped sleeve remains at the distant intact upper-left end. Show a supple curved hose with no rigid right-angle elbow. Broad solid silhouettes, at most two large black sleeve cuts. NO faucet, tap, valve handle, water spout, plumbing pipe, oil can, gear, fine braid texture, tiny wires, lettering or extra drops.
CELLS 7, 8 AND 9: COMPLETELY EMPTY PURE BLACK. No glyphs, marks, duplicates or filler. Preserve this exact layout.
